title: Heist Movies
intro: The plan looks perfect until the human element walks in. These are heists where tension lives in every pause and glance.

films.title: Heat
films.line: Two men on opposite sides of the law locked in a dance neither can escape.

films.title: Rififi
films.line: A 28-minute wordless heist sequence that still leaves the room breathless.

films.title: Inside Man
films.line: Nothing about this bank robbery is what it appears to be, and that's the whole game.

films.title: Thief
films.line: A man who has mastered stealing everything except control of his own life.

films.title: A Simple Plan
films.line: Finding a fortune in the snow turns ordinary people into strangers to themselves.

films.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
films.line: Loyalty and survival collide in the most quietly devastating crime film ever made.
